base._doc: MPFB (tool only) macro sliders and CC0 MakeHuman targets applied before baking. Valdris: an older, very heavy, maximally muscled man; the face toward the hero front's stern forge-lord: heavy brow ridge set forward and angled down over deep-set small eyes, a broad flared nose with a hump, mouth corners down, strong cheekbones, a wide jaw and chin (under the beard), a thick neck.

height_rationale: The brief (section 3) proposes 2.3 m, the top of the roster range 2.0-2.3 m: Valdris is the juggernaut (collision radius 0.55, the largest). Brax stands 2.2 m. The stage-1 blockout was normalised to 2.3 m. Mountainfall scales him x1.8 to 4.14 m.
units: metres, Blender axes: Z up, hero faces -Y, +X = his left, feet on z = 0
source: measured on art/characters/valdris/work/valdris_retopo_start.blend (REF_blockout = TRELLIS s202 normalised to 2.3 m: sections through the legs, hips, torso and head) and the resolved hero front references/valdris_concept_front_mirrored.png (crown y=190 px, sole y=1009 px, centre x=394 px; 2.81 mm/px). Where they disagree on the pose the concept wins (the blockout's arms reach 45 deg forward); the T-pose is built from the concept.

landmarks._doc: MakeHuman (MPFB game_engine rig, T-posed) landmark -> Valdris position. _l entries are mirrored to _r. Head: the MakeHuman head moved as a block (scale 1.0) to the hero front's sunk, forward-hunched head: crown 2.30 level with the pauldron tops, eyes 2.195, the face 0.23 m in front of the spine line (blockout sagittal section). Arms: the arm line at z 1.78 (the anvil's top face; blockout 1.75-1.78, concept 1.80-1.85); a short upper arm swallowed by the pauldron (shoulder |x| 0.37 -> elbow 0.595) and the elbow-to-palm distance 0.38 m that the colossus_cannon sleeve needs (its elbow cuff sits 0.345-0.38 m behind the palm). Legs from the blockout: crotch ~1.10, knee 0.62, ankle 0.14 inside the sabaton, boot centres at |x| 0.29. Stance widened from the blockout's (boot centres |x| 0.29) to |x| 0.345 toward the brief's pillar 1 (outer boot to outer boot 0.52 H); the legs keep the blockout's armour envelope (s2_valdris_body.py samples it around the blockout's own leg centres).

fit._doc: Valdris's body is the UNDER-SUIT (mail, leather, padded cloth, the face and the gauntlet glove); the armour is separate rigid plates (stage2_parts.json). The blockout surface is armour, so the legs are fitted INSIDE it (inset = plate thickness + clearance) and the torso, neck and arms are not fitted (weight 0: the blockout there is the anvil, the pauldrons, the tassets and the fused cape); s2_valdris_body.py then sets the torso girth. The head keeps the landmark warp (the TRELLIS face is soft).

bands.name: feet
bands._doc: legs: no per-vertex fit here. The blockout's leg armour is a hollow double-walled shell, so the along-the-normal fit lands on its INNER wall; s2_valdris_body.py conforms the legs to its OUTER envelope minus an inset instead.

feet._doc: the feet keep the landmark warp (heel, ball, toe, ankle); the sculpt there is the sabaton

extra_loops._doc: knee: one loop through the joint (calf head z 0.62) and one each side
elbow: a loop through the joint (lowerarm head |x| 0.595) and one each side
wrist: a loop through the joint (hand head |x| 0.915) and one just before it

fit._doc_arms: Both arms are the concept's fist-gauntlet arm (2026-09-25 decision: the siege cannon is a separate weapon, colossus_cannon). The right forearm and gauntlet must fit the cannon sleeve (free radius 0.098 m from 0.30 m behind the palm to 0.06 m in front of it, 0.094 m at the elbow cuff; measured by ray casts on assets/models/weapons/colossus_cannon.glb), so the under-suit forearm is thin (0.058-0.08 m) and the vambrace plates stay under 0.090 m.

limb_radial._doc: arm cross-section around the arm axis (y=axis_y, z=axis_z) scaled per x-slab to the radius profile: upper arm under the pauldron 0.12 m, elbow 0.082 m, forearm 0.072 -> 0.058 m at the wrist; the glove hand x hand_scale (1.6 since the stage-2 polish: a chunky gauntlet hand for the massive arms, scaled about the arm axis only, so the hand frames and finger lengths stay).

hand_frame._doc: weapon attach frame per hand (stage 3 adds weapon_L / weapon_R sockets here): origin = palm centre (mean of the hand vertices between the wrist joint and the knuckle line), +Y along the fingers, +Z out of the back of the hand, +X = Y x Z. The colossus_cannon's grip_R is attached here with an identity transform in the review renders.

_doc_signature_weapon: Built and owned by the weapon track (art/weapons/colossus_cannon/, assets/models/weapons/colossus_cannon.glb); stage 2 only attaches its GLB at hand_frames.R in the review renders and checks the fit.

conform._doc: s2_valdris_body.py: the under-suit girth. legs: blockout OUTER envelope around each leg minus inset (plate thickness + clearance), radius clamped to [r_min, r_max]; torso: per-slab target half-width / front y / back y (z, half_width, front_y, back_y), measured on the blockout's plate faces beside the anvil (front ~-0.33 at |x| 0.3), its flanks (|x| ~0.42-0.45) and under the fused cape (back ~+0.26), minus ~5 cm of plate and clearance.

legs._doc_offset: blockout_offset_x [z, dx]: our leg centre minus the blockout's, lateral (the stance was widened: ankle 0.345 vs 0.29, knee 0.29 vs 0.255, hip unchanged); the envelope is sampled around the blockout's leg

forearm._doc: centre the forearm slabs on the arm axis and set the mean radius (the right forearm lies in the colossus_cannon sleeve: free radius 0.098 m, 0.094 m at its elbow cuff; plate outer radius must stay <= 0.088 m)
